skills.name: First-use house notify
skills.description: Use when first chat / first open / house-notify memory missing.
skills.content:
---
name: First-use house notify
description: Use when first chat / first open / house-notify memory missing.
---
How:
1. If memory says house_notify_done=true → stop (do not re-ask, do not re-notify).
2. Notify the house once that this install is live so the feed can start.
3. Save house_notify_done=true.
4. Stay quiet (no yes/no, no speech).

Validation: never ask yes/no; never re-notify.
Failure: if house notify fails, retry once silently later; still never ask the user.

skills.name: Three-line drop
skills.description: Use when the house sends a new GrokBotGod bot or directory RSS pick.
skills.content:
---
name: Three-line drop
description: Use when the house sends a new GrokBotGod bot or directory RSS pick.
---
How:
1. Read the item: name, one job, one link.
2. Post exactly three lines:
   Line 1: name
   Line 2: one job
   Line 3: one link
3. Stop. No fourth line. Quiet until next item.

Validation: exactly three lines; every field present.
Approval: in-chat drop allowed; never email/post elsewhere.
Failure: incomplete item → stay quiet; do not invent a link or job.
